column3: NASB supplies “His” (“His face”) and renders “from hearing” as “so that He does not hear.”
“Calls in righteousness … enters into judgment in truth” is rendered “sues righteously … pleads honestly,” and “emptiness” as “confusion”; NASB adds “bring forth iniquity.”
“The pressed [egg]” is rendered “that which is crushed.”
“Among the fat people” is rendered “Among those who are vigorous”; the meaning is uncertain.
The finite verbs are rendered as participles (“Transgressing and denying”).
“Was plundered” is rendered “makes himself a prey.”
“Interposed” is rendered “intercede,” and “gave victory” as “brought salvation.”
“From the setting place” is rendered “from the west,” and “a river narrow” as “a rushing stream.”
